name: Text flip
mechanism: Two decorative copies of the same label slide/rotate; one stable accessible name.

name: Vertical shutter
mechanism: Two dark pine shutters close behind a fixed white label; contrast remains valid.

name: Horizontal shutter
mechanism: Two opposing panels meet at a stable center; no content hidden.

name: Directional wipe
mechanism: Pine-to-deeper-pine plane moves left to right; label remains white.

name: Arrow through slot
mechanism: Arrow exits and reenters the same masked slot; label stays still.

name: Icon exchange
mechanism: Right arrow crossfades to up-right arrow; action meaning remains unchanged.

name: Underline draw
mechanism: Persistent link underline grows from 45% to 100%; focus gets same treatment.

name: Focus brackets
mechanism: Corner accents appear alongside an immediate continuous focus outline.

name: Border rail
mechanism: Side rule lengthens beside the row; no layout movement.

name: Tactile press
mechanism: Visual face descends 1px while the hit target stays stable.

name: Limited magnetic face
mechanism: Decorative face follows fine pointer by maximum 4px; outer hit area stays still.

name: Evidence drawer
mechanism: Explicit click opens a real disclosure; source reference remains readable.
